title: King Charles to call on tech giants for 'reassurances' over AI
description: King Charles III will urge tech giants to ensure that artificial intelligence is geared to serve humanity and that mankind does "not lose control", during a conference in Scotland on Thursday. "Those in our world who value our humanity and its vital moral component are anxiously seeking your reassurance that we will not lose control of our destiny," Charles will say at the opening of the conference, according to a statement from the palace.
